contexts.text: Where is the corn and wine? () = where are love and faith?
A multitude of corn () = thence natural good, (because predicated of the Natural). Illustrated. AC 3597:4.
Corn () = spiritual good.
Corn () = all the good of the Church. AC 10137:4.
Corn = the good of the Natural. AC 5295. AC 5342.
The reason corn = good, is that a field = the Church...
Joseph heaped up corn as the sand of the sea, very much () = the multiplication of truth by good... Corn = truth in will and act.
To buy corn from Egypt () = to appropriate to themselves the good of truth through scientifics. Corn = the good of truth.
They filled their vessels with corn () = that scientifics were endowed with good from truth... Corn = good from truth, or the good of truth. AC 5614. AC 5939.
By the corn which they receive this time signified interior life, for now they are with Benjamin.
Corn = good.

Ten she donkeys carrying corn and bread () = the good of truth, and the truth of good. Corn = the good of truth, but here, the truth of good because from the celestial Internal, which is Joseph. Explained.
Corn = the good which is from truth, and also the truth of good.
Corn, in general, = the good of truth; barley, and wheat, in special...
Corn () = the good of truth.
Corn () = the good of the truth of faith. AC 9296:5.
Corn () = the interior good of the Spiritual Church.
Corn () = the good of truth.
Corn = the good from which is truth. References.
Corn () = good of every kind in the external man.
That thence they will have love towards a brother and companion, is signified by, the floors shall be full of pure corn ().
Corn and new wine () = all good and truth in the natural man.
Corn () = natural truth.
Corn and wine () = the good of doctrine and its truth.
Corn shall make the young men grow, and new wine the maids () = that the understanding of truth and the affection of truth will be formed through good and through truth by Him.
The floors are full of corn () = the celestial good which they have in abundance.
